summary: Behrend's campaign page demands San Francisco divest completely and immediately from Israel and stop renewing contracts with companies doing business there, explicitly calling Israel's actions 'genocide and apartheid.' On June 28, 2026, he publicly attacked Supervisor Scott Wiener for opposing the city's 2024 ceasefire resolution, invoking ICJ war-crimes citations. CAIR Action endorsed him and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally in the general election.
